body.title: docs/workflow.md and the documentation test
body.summary: Describe the Epic impact analysis, the digest and its caps, the epicImpact section of the LLD and PLAN, the BUILD paragraph and the approval check (the refusal, the override, when it does not apply) in docs/workflow.md, and add a docs test that reads the label, the kind and the caps from the code and fails when the doc names a different one.
acceptanceChecks: docs/workflow.md describes the Epic impact analysis, the digest and its caps and the BUILD approval check in line with the code
the docs test passes and fails when the doc names a different label, kind or cap, or states a wrong rule

tests.name: build-commands-doc.test.ts or a docs test: docs/workflow.md describes the Epic impact analysis, the digest and its caps and the BUILD approval check in line with the code
